verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair privacy question for a SaaS billing platform and its SDKs, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any telemetry, analytics, or usage-tracking opt-out. The 'usage events' docs describe ingesting customers' metered-billing data, which is a different subject and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
